title: world wallet
tagline: ZKP HD Wallets using Worldcoin. Using BIP32 and BIP39 to create a universal biometrically proven wallet.
description:
Platform that can take legal documents, scrap them, store all info in on chain (decentralized). With this each document will be tracked and have an expiration date, mostly because medical documents can expire. 

Legal Docs
Medical
Covid Vaccine
Legal
Passport
SSN
Drivers License
Storing Info
Expiration Date
On/off chain communication
Apple FaceID integration
Android Biometric integration
Tie Wallet
Timing (airport tickets)
